The mysterious white, long-tailed creature that was previously caught on camera climbing a wall on the US-Mexico border has come to the fore again. UFO researcher Jaime Maussan, speaking about the creature associated with the abduction of chickens, roosters and rabbits, said the creature may have come from another dimension. Officials, however, stated that there were no official reports of attacks on animals in the region.

IT HAD PREVIOUSLY BEEN FILMED WHILE CLIMBING A WALL

The mysterious creature caught on camera in Mexico's Juárez Valley, opposite the city of El Paso in the US state of Texas, has once again become the focus of debate.

In footage shared on October 17, the white, hairless and long-tailed creature was seen climbing a large brick wall.

Researchers who examined the footage stated that the creature is about 1.8 meters long from head to tail, with its tail reaching 90 centimeters.

IT CAME TO PROMINENCE WITH THE DISAPPEARANCE OF CHICKENS, ROOSTERS AND RABBITS

After chickens, roosters and rabbits went missing in the area, the mysterious creature drew attention.

UFO researcher Jaime Maussan recounted that a child saw the creature grab a chicken by the head and climb a tree.

Thereupon, the research team, which installed motion-sensor cameras in the area, filmed the mysterious creature.

"THIS IS A PREDATOR, BUT I AM NOT SAYING IT IS EXTRATERRESTRIAL"

Maussan, who argues that the creature has characteristics different from known animal species, made striking statements about the creature's origin.

Saying, "This is a predator. I am not saying it is extraterrestrial, but it is something frightening," Maussan suggested that the creature may have crossed into Earth from another dimension.

STATEMENT FROM OFFICIALS

Juárez Civil Protection officials announced that they had not received any official reports regarding attacks by a dangerous creature in the area.

Officials on the US side also stated that no notifications had reached them regarding the killing of livestock or encounters with an unusual creature.

While it has not yet been determined which animal species the mysterious creature belongs to, claims that it came from another dimension have not been scientifically verified.
